newsitem.title: USA: UNR Industries votes regular, extra div.
newsitem.headline: UNR Industries votes regular, extra div.

text.p: UNR Industries Inc said Thursday its board voted a regular $0.25 per share dividend and an extraordinary dividend of $0.35 per share.
Both are payable December 23, record December 16.

"These dividends represent a partial liquidatiion distribution of the proceeds of the sales of the company's discontinued divisions and a portion of our current year's earnings," said president Thomas Gildenhaus in a statement.
UNR manufactures towers, shelters, cabinets and mounts for the telecommunications industry.
